identity_rule: settle only when current offer triggerId matches
commit_order: Atomically commit settled triggerId and ACCEPT as the immutable winning cause before sending the decision; then send; then close this screen if still current.
send_failure: A send failure is retained as primary and closing this screen is still attempted.
transition_failure: A close failure leaves the committed winner unchanged; later terminal paths remain NOOP.
exception_rule: If send and close both fail, throw the send failure and add the close failure as suppressed in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit at most one CHOSEN InsightDecision; after either failure the offer remains terminal and cannot emit again.

identity_rule: settle only when current offer triggerId matches
commit_order: Atomically commit settled triggerId and DECLINE as the immutable winning cause before sending the decision; then send; then close this screen if still current.
send_failure: A send failure is retained as primary and closing this screen is still attempted.
transition_failure: A close failure leaves the committed winner unchanged; later terminal paths remain NOOP.
exception_rule: If send and close both fail, throw the send failure and add the close failure as suppressed in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit at most one DECLINED InsightDecision; after either failure the offer remains terminal and cannot emit again.

identity_rule: A shared exactly-once terminal claim keyed by the same triggerId is accepted from pre-open bootstrap or the open screen only once
commit_order: Atomically commit the shared triggerId and TIMEOUT as the immutable winning cause before sending any fallible decision; pre-open bootstrap may settle without constructing a screen, while an open screen uses the same claim and then closes if still current.
send_failure: A send failure is retained as primary; the committed TIMEOUT winner remains terminal and the applicable close/transition stage is still attempted.
transition_failure: A transition or screen-removal failure leaves the committed winner unchanged; later bootstrap, screen, or removal observations remain NOOP.
exception_rule: If send and transition both fail, throw the send failure and add the transition failure as suppressed in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit at most one TIMED_OUT InsightDecision for the triggerId; pre-open expiry never creates a screen and no later path can double-settle it.

identity_rule: settle only when current offer triggerId matches
commit_order: Atomically commit settled triggerId and ESC as the immutable winning cause before sending the decline; then send; then close this screen if still current.
send_failure: A send failure is retained as primary and closing this screen is still attempted.
transition_failure: A close or removal-hook failure leaves the committed winner unchanged; the later onRemoved terminal path is NOOP.
exception_rule: If send and close or removal both fail, throw the first failure and add later failures as suppressed in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit at most one DECLINED InsightDecision; subsequent onRemoved callback emits nothing and cannot replace ESC as winner.

identity_rule: bootstrap compares outgoing and replacement triggerId before transition; handler settles the outgoing identity once
commit_order: Atomically commit the outgoing triggerId and REPLACED_BY_DIFFERENT_OFFER before sending its decline; then send; then switch to the different offer, which becomes authoritative only after the outgoing commit.
send_failure: A send failure is retained as primary and switching to the replacement is still attempted.
transition_failure: A switch failure leaves the outgoing winner committed and the replacement non-authoritative; later terminal paths for the outgoing triggerId remain NOOP.
exception_rule: If send and switch both fail, throw the send failure and add the switch failure as suppressed in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit at most one DECLINED InsightDecision for the outgoing triggerId; replacement cannot strand or re-settle the outgoing offer after either failure.

identity_rule: settle the same triggerId when no prior terminal cause won
commit_order: Atomically commit settled triggerId and REMOVED_EXCEPTIONALLY before sending the decline; then send; then allow BongScreenBase removal cleanup and super.removed to continue.
send_failure: A send failure is retained as primary and later removal lifecycle stages are still attempted.
transition_failure: A later removal-stage failure leaves the committed winner unchanged; later terminal paths remain NOOP.
exception_rule: BongScreenBase throws the first failure and adds later removal failures as suppressed in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit at most one DECLINED InsightDecision through the removal hook; exceptional removal cannot leave the offer unsettled or permit a retry.

identity_rule: settled triggerId and first terminal cause are immutable
commit_order: Observe the already committed winner and return before decision send or any screen transition.
transition_failure: No screen switch is attempted by the duplicate path; the committed winner remains unchanged.
exception_rule: No new exception is produced by the duplicate path.
observable_effect: Emit no second decision, perform no second transition, and do not mutate the winning cause.
